main.description: Get a single catalogue collection by its AT-URI, optionally with its immediate children and its ancestor chain. Depth is bounded and small: there is deliberately no unbounded-recursion surface, and deeper walks paginate pub.layers.catalog.listMembers per node.

uri.description: AT-URI of the collection to fetch.

depth.description: How many levels of descendants to include in children. 0 returns the record alone. Capped at 3 because browse renders two levels and a count, never a tree.

includeAncestors.description: Include the parentRef chain from this collection up to its root, for breadcrumbs.

resolvePins.description: When the collection declares pinPolicy 'pinned', resolve each member at the CID its edge names rather than at its current revision.

cid.description: CID of the returned collection's current revision.

pinnedUri.description: The pinned citation form: this record's AT-URI together with the CID under which the appview resolved it. Computed at read time, because a record cannot carry its own CID: writing the value would change it.

ancestors.description: The parentRef chain, root first. Empty when this collection is a root.

children.description: Collections whose parentRef points at this one, ordered by ordinal then name. Truncated at the page limit; use listMembers for the full set.

descendantCollectionCount.description: Number of collections in this one's subtree along the containment spine, computed by the appview. 0 for a leaf, which is what lets a ragged hierarchy render uniformly: every child is a card and the count says whether it opens.

collectionView.description: A collection as it appears in a browse row: the record, its identity, and the two derived numbers a card needs.

cid.description: CID of this collection's current revision.

descendantCollectionCount.description: Number of collections in this one's subtree along the containment spine.
